title: Change your PIN
description: Short XRP Mobile tutorial: change your wallet PIN from Settings, Security. The app asks for your current PIN before it lets you set a new one, so nobody holding your unlocked phone can change it blind. The new PIN unlocks the app and signs every transaction from then on.
lede: If anyone has seen you type your PIN, change it. It takes about twenty seconds, and the app makes sure it is really you first.

steps.caption: Settings, then Security
steps.body: Open the gear and move to the Security tab. This is where the PIN, your backup and deleting your data all live.

steps.caption: Prove it is you first
steps.body: It asks for the PIN you have now before it lets you set a new one. Someone holding your unlocked phone still cannot change it blind.

steps.caption: Enter the new PIN
steps.body: Now the new one. Four digits, and please not your year of birth or the code to your front door.

steps.caption: Confirm it
steps.body: Type it again to confirm. If the two do not match, nothing changes and you start over.

steps.caption: Changed
steps.body: Changed. The new PIN unlocks the app and signs your transactions from now on.
